visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a photobooth called 'THE LOUD ROOM' with red and white wavy patterned walls, a young woman with short dark hair wearing a white sweater smiles and poses. (2) She pulls back a red curtain to reveal a showroom; she walks through a doorway topped with a large white bow into a bright, white-lit luxury retail space. (3) She approaches white drawers and shelves displaying pink Miss Dior products; she picks up a silver and pink patterned lipstick tube and smells it with a smile. (4) Transition to a perfume testing area where she holds a glass perfume bottle decorated with a grey fabric bow, pointing to personalized embroidery on the ribbon. (5) She sits at a pink makeup vanity station, looking at an eyeshadow palette and a blush compact while holding a brush. (6) She stands in front of a white shelving unit holding a large white gift box with 'CHRISTIAN DIOR' printed on it, pointing at the logo. (7) Back in the photobooth, she touches a touchscreen, then poses with her hands over her head forming a heart as a camera flash effect occurs.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: THE LOUD ROOM. [Subtitle]: 情人節要怎麼過 幫你們想好了. (2) [Subtitle]: 女生們請把這篇 分享給另一半. (3) [Subtitle]: MISS DIOR 訂製愛戀快閃店 來到信義區啦!. (4) [Subtitle]: 充滿粉紅泡泡的時髦裝置 有好多東西可以逛. (5) [Logo]: MISS DIOR 親吻香膏區. [Subtitle]: 像是訂製衣櫃的親吻香膏區. (6) [Subtitle]: 除了有經典的千鳥格包裝外 也有最新的 MISS DIOR 限量外殼. (7) [Subtitle]: 唇膏尺寸設計很方便攜帶 跟你們說最新的星辰茉莉味道超好聞. (8) [Subtitle]: 隨時讓身上保持香香的. (9) [Logo]: 香氛體驗區. [Subtitle]: 走進香氛體驗區 這裡擺了各種經典香氛. (10) [Subtitle]: 買香水的話瓶身還能客製刺繡蝴蝶結 還可以繡上字母 打造獨一無二的香水. (11) [Slogan]: 奢華訂製珍藏版. [Subtitle]: 順便欣賞全世界只有150件的奢華訂製珍藏版 也太美了吧!. (12) [Logo]: MISS DIOR 訂製愛戀試妝區. [Subtitle]: 香水逛不過癮也能搶先體驗彩妝新品 聽說這兩款在日本伊勢丹百貨 一上市就排隊賣爆!. (13) [Logo]: 情人節限定包裝服務區. [Subtitle]: 貼心的DIOR甚至推出情人節限定包裝服務 讓禮物質感更上一層樓. (14) [Subtitle]: 只要消費就能體驗拍照機喔 2025/2/6~2025/2/16 地點就在信義新光A11一樓 趕快約另一半或好姊妹來逛逛吧.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-tempo upbeat electronic pop music begins with a bright synth lead and a steady 4/4 drum beat. A female voice with an enthusiastic, high-energy tone begins a narrative introduction. (2) A synthesized 'whoosh' sound effect occurs, marking the transition from the photobooth to the main showroom. The music continues with a consistent energy level as the narrator describes the shop's atmosphere. (3) A sharp 'ding' or bell-like chime triggers when a specific product is highlighted on screen, emphasizing its novelty. The vocal delivery remains expressive with rising intonations. (4) A melodic 'sparkle' SFX sounds as limited-edition perfume bottles are revealed. The background environment has a very faint, low-arousal crowd murmur typical of a high-end mall. (5) The music continues seamlessly into the makeup trial section. The narrator's speech rate remains moderate and clear. (6) A final camera shutter sound ('click-snap') triggers multiple times at the end to match the photobooth flash visual, ending with a cheerful final call to action from the speaker.
